'''Aratech''' was a group of six [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] that transported [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and were of unknown relation to the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Company]]. Each freighter was designated with a number from 2-7. The ships were present at the ''[[Destreg Spaceport]]'' when [[K'Armyn Viraxo]]'s personal [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Highroller]]'', was destroyed by [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]] and [[Emon Azzameen]]. However, K'Armyn had got wind of this and used the yacht as a trap against the Azzameens. Despite this both Ace and Emon escaped the ambush by destroying all of the bounty hunters.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
